Good morning, everyone. I've called this meeting to conduct the final review of the internal review findings regarding the payments involving our foreign reseller that triggered sanctions-screening alerts. As you know, no communication has been sent to OFAC yet, the reseller relationship is still active, and we're still holding funds connected with those reviewed payments.

Before I can sign off on any regulator submission or any action regarding the reseller, our policy requires each functional lead to formally document their findings in the disclosure record using the formal finding-entry step for their area. I need sanctions, trade compliance, treasury, and commercial operations to each complete that step before we can close this review.

Let's begin. Could each of you walk us through your area's findings and then enter them formally into the record?
